# Exam Prompt

> Universal AI-powered exam preparation skill hub for any university worldwide. 30+ skills turn any AI coding agent into a personal exam tutor. Pre-configured for SPPU Computer Engineering. Adapts to any university via syllabus PDF input.

## Core structure

- `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` — Complete skill instructions (the "brain"). Read the relevant SKILL.md before generating any exam output.
- `AGENTS.md` — XML skill registry with all 30+ skills. Auto-discovered by Cursor, Windsurf, OpenCode, and Claude Code.
- `CLAUDE.md` — Quick-reference skill table with key paths and commands.
- `AGENT-GUIDE.md` — Full agent onboarding: skill discovery, multi-step workflows, platform configs for all agents.
- `ARCHITECTURE.md` — Canonical architecture overview (layers, data flow, design decisions).
- `AGENTS_LEARNING.md` — Cross-session learning log. Read before starting new work to avoid past mistakes.
- `examples/<year>/<sem>/<subject>/` — Sample papers + solutions organized by year/semester/subject.
- `universities/<UNIVERSITY>/` — Per-university configs, branches, patterns, syllabus.
- `scripts/` — Utility scripts (validate, fetch PYQs, generate, convert PDFs).
- `infrastructure/` — Agent runtime tools: skill-router, output-validator, session-context, cache-manager.
- `deps/` — Dependency resolution system (`deps/resolve.sh`).
- `skills-dependency-graph.json` — Which skills depend on which (automated workflow composition).
- `pyq-index/` — Index of 563 SPPU previous year question papers (actual PDFs not in repo).
- `docs/` — GitHub Pages website (landing, skill browser, app).

## How agents should use this repo

1. User asks an exam question → find the right skill in `AGENTS.md` → read its `SKILL.md` → follow instructions step-by-step.
2. Optionally use `infrastructure/skill-router.js` for automatic skill detection from query text.
3. Validate output quality using checkpoints in `.cursor/rules/004-quality-gate.mdc`.
4. Default university: SPPU 2019 Pattern (6 units, 4 OR pairs, 70 marks, 2.5 hrs). Default generic: 5 units, 100 marks, 3 hrs.
5. Never invent university patterns — use `skills/universal-university-adapter/SKILL.md` for unknown patterns.
6. Never edit SKILL.md files unless explicitly asked.
7. Bold technical terms on first use in exam answers.
8. Read `AGENTS_LEARNING.md` before starting — it contains lessons from past sessions.

## Infrastructure tools (agent runtime)

| Tool | Command | Purpose |
|------|---------|---------|
| Skill Router | `node infrastructure/skill-router.js` | Auto-detect skill from user query |
| Output Validator | `npm run validate:output` | Validate output against 5 skill schemas (AJV) |
| Session Context | `npm run session:view` | View persistent user profile |
| Cache Manager | `npm run cache:stats` | View cache statistics |
| Infra Status | `npm run infra:status` | Full infrastructure health check |

## Quick start commands

- `make validate` — Validate all skill structures
- `make quickstart` — Install deps + validate (one command)
- `bash deps/resolve.sh` — Check and install project dependencies
- `node scripts/fetch-qp.js <subject>` — Download PYQs from web
- `node -e "require('./package.json')"` — Verify package.json is valid JSON

## Agent config files (one per platform)

- Claude Code: `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/settings.json`, `.claudeignore`
- Cursor: `.cursorrules`, `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`
- Windsurf: `.windsurfrules`
- Aider: `.aider.conf.yml`, `.aiderignore`
- Cline: `.clinerules`, `cline_docs/`
- GitHub Copilot: `.github/copilot-instructions.md`
- Continue.dev: `.continue/config.yaml`
- OpenCode: `.opencode.jsonc` (auto-reads AGENTS.md)

## Optional

- `docs/ci-cd-reference.md` — CI/CD pipeline documentation
